talks.title: The Path of Love
talks.summary: We are not living the way God has designed humans to live their lives. We are living unnaturally. That's why we have become fake, false. And that's the very reason that we are suffering.
paragraphs: We are not living the way God has designed humans to live their lives. We are living unnaturally. That's why we have become fake, false. And that's the very reason that we are suffering.

We must understand, that what is this game? A newly born child, he remains absorbed in feeling the Divine within and with closed eyes, seeing the divine light of different colors and celestial music. He remains absorbed in that.

And when he comes out of that, he starts kicking with his feet and arms and laughing. So what does he do? He plays with himself. That consciousness in that child plays in itself because consciousness is alive.
The same way the ocean plays with itself. And while playing with itself, the bubbles, the foam, the waves are created. Exactly the same way God plays with Himself.

God loves Himself. Love always creates relationship. God loves himself. We too would love ourselves as we start moving closer to God. And God loves Himself. He keeps playing and while playing, He has created all this universe. Just like the ocean creates and then demolishes. God too, the same thing.

The nature of life is to create and destroy, too. Create, sustain and destroy. The same thing we are doing. We are creating, too. We are creating homes, jobs, this and that. And some are taken off the board, some new things are added.
We are the divine lights. And the nature of the divine light is to create, is to create, sustain and destroy. Create. That's why God's name is creator.
And because we are separated from ourselves, we have created an illusionary world of our own, our little family, friends, coworkers, and few more.
So the right way of living life is the path on which we meet ourselves and recognize who we are. And while living outside, living in this world, living out of our minds, can we ever meet ourselves?

The most beautiful gift, human body, human consciousness. But you're living it the wrong ways, damaging yourself. Don't know at all, you don't even know who you are. So what is the point in doing all this?
So we must go home. The outer life is not going to stop, but the outer life is going to change.
The right way of living life. And what's that? Living life out of love and humility. That we will become through meditation.

Through meditation, we come home and when we come within and recognize that “I'm the divine light”, instantly it becomes clear to us that “I am immortal.” What a way, “ path of love ”! This way of living life is the way of love.

Our mind will try every possible way to avoid entering the inner world. He will put the blame on others for not being able to go into the inner world. It would use our bodies as victims that “If I sit for a long time, then my body starts feeling weak” and all that…
When we don't live our lives correctly by following the mind only, then our body becomes angry with us. It falls sick. It becomes tense, worried, because of the mind.
Whenever we have a thought to do something which is not right, immediately we feel fear within. That is God's way of telling us, "Don't do this. Don't do this."
This is His way of telling by creating fear in us. And if we are going on the right direction, he makes us feel happy. God many times said ‘No’ to us, "Don't, don't." But the mind did not listen.

The sun rises and sets in stillness, in calmness, quietness while remaining tranquil, not in any hurry. Not in any hurry to rise or not in any hurry to set. That's our nature. Meditation and our daily, weekly commitment brings that stillness in us.
And as we start becoming more and more still, God keeps moving towards us closer and closer.
This is the path of love, to create a loving relationship with God.

talks.title: The Epitome of Human Courage
talks.summary: We were pulled out of our homes within this body, when we were young, and the world showed us so much, and made sure that we forgot our homes.
paragraphs: We were pulled out of our homes within this body, when we were young, and the world showed us so much, and made sure that we forgot our homes.
Everyday, we became more and more attached to the outer world, a movie, and the more we are attached to the outer world, more difficult it is now to go home.
Some of us will find it difficult to focus, that's the proof, that we are very tightly attached to the outer world. The outer world has control over us.

So, we immediately have to take control of our thoughts, energy, social media, all the noise within and all the things people, places, we are attached to. We have to retract our consciousness from those places, things, people and come home.
Feel our insides, get to know ourselves, and get to know our nature. Then we would find out that our nature is humility, kindness and love .
Beg Him with your utmost humility, that oh Divine, please help me to become relieved from all the attachments, so that I can come home, and know myself.
This HKL Movement is the movement of waking up and to meet our beings. Waking up and to meet our beings, get to know ourselves, our real selves.
We must not, and we must not lose the game of life this time.

We are already within God, surrounded by God, God is attached to us from outside, from within. And it is our mind which tells us that our insides and outsides are two different worlds. Through meditation, the boundaries of our bodies evaporate, and our insides become one with the universe.
With meditation, while keeping the name of the Divine in our consciousness, we come home, and meet our beings.

The most important relationship in this world is our relationship with ourselves, with our being. Throughout our lives, we dwell with ourselves, we remain with ourselves, and we leave this world with ourselves only. So, we must recognise the place of our relationship with ourselves in this world.

We should recognise ourselves, and recognise that we all are the Divine light, we all are humility, kindness and love. And then we would have that state of consciousness, state of humility, kindness and love.
We should live out of that space, and then we should become an inspiration for others. And you should move in this world as an Angel, as an Angel of humility, kindness and love.
We should go to others, walking with the feet of love.

We should become an inspiration for the world, and help the whole world to recognise who they are. And this longing is the epitome of human courage. This longing, with the grace of God to transfer the consciousness of all of humanity, this is the epitome of human courage. And we all are blessed with that courage.
We are here on this earth to become a poem, a poem of humility, kindness and love, and help make others this poem. All life on this earth, this poem.
Oh my beloved precious ones, just turn your heart towards Me for a short time, I want to talk to your heart.

This body of yours, is a sacred temple of the Divine, within it dwells the Divine light. Honour it. Honour your body, the sacred temple of God, and honour every other body, too. They all are sacred temples of God.

Now we are being governed by our minds and our minds are the king, emperor of us, we have to dethrone it, replace it, with humility, kindness and love. Don't let your mind be the ruler of you, it should be humility, kindness and love.

talks.title: The Ladder of Truth Within
talks.summary: The question is: Where is the line between humility, looking weak, and lacking confidence?
paragraphs: The question is: Where is the line between humility, looking weak, and lacking confidence?
Because we all are walking on the path of HKL , we must have crystal clear understanding about humility.

This must be understood very clearly that the child, little child always remains connected with their insides, with eyes closed. And as the child grows and enters into the 11-12 years, then their, his or her, attention, is pulled outside.

He is forced to leave his home, because he is shown so mesmerizing interesting things outside. So he is pulled outside of his home, and he is shown so much at that tender age. And he becomes entangled in those things, that he completely forgets that he is living out of his home.

He doesn't know where his home is. He doesn't know what teachings he was imparted with at home. Now, he remains outside all the time, day and night, his attention remains focused on some people, some places, some things, some jobs, so many things.
He doesn't know how to live, he is just reacting. Everybody is outside, and they don't know, everybody is separated from their own beings.
That young person is pulled out of their home, he is separated from their own selves, and outside is everybody separated from their own selves and everybody is living in an illusionary world.
Everybody is living in a dream world, ‘‘I want a house like that!’’, dreams, dreams, dreams… ‘‘My dream is this!’’. And those dreams never get realised.

Nobody is living outside; they are reacting to each other’s behaviour. They don't know who they are, they don't know where they are standing, they don't know where they are sitting, they don't know who they are, because they have been separated from themselves.
When, with good fortune and His grace, we start waking up through meditation, and practising the daily HKL practises .

When we start waking up, and we are told that you always remain connected to earth, which is the most humble out of all of His creation. You always remain connected with the most humble being, the earth, and you are always moving within God, God is not away from you, you are within God, outside, and God is within you too.

And when this is understood, when one wakes up, everything changes for him/her; ‘‘I am standing in God?’’ Yes! He cannot be seen with these eyes, but this is God. You are always within God, sitting, standing, eating, sleeping, working, and you are always connected with the most humble of His creation.
With this understanding, with this knowledge, we wake up, and that state of consciousness cannot be talked about, that can only be experienced. That is the state of consciousness of humility.

Humility is a state of consciousness. It has got absolutely nothing with the outward world. You would meet a beggar with the same humility, same respect, as you meet a King, because you are living naturally, as God created you.

For you, King and beggar are no different, they both are temples of God. King and beggar, tomorrow the beggar could be a King and the King could be a beggar! But one thing for certain, never changing, that they both are temples of God. This state is humility.
So, the question of looking weak, or lacking confidence, doesn't arise.

There is God within this body. And when with good fortune, we get to listen to the truth, we feel the pain of separation from ourselves. We recognise I am always away from home, I am always away from myself. I don't even know who I am.

We are shown, sun and moon, that both of them, they rise with such stillness, with such tranquility, that they rise in total tranquility, they move in total tranquility and then they, in total tranquility, disappear into the other side, while remaining in deep peace, tranquility. There is no anxiety, there are no worries, there is no sadness, there is no reaction.
So, this tranquility of life is the most beautiful aspect, and this we can only experience when we wake up. Humility, kindness and love emerge from there.
Worship the heart area. Worship the heart area, that's where you're supposed to live. This consciousness which is wandering outside, it's home is there at the heart area.
Come home, dwell there, that's where you are going to see who you are. Worship this place, because this is such a blessed place, the heart area.

This is where your rebirth is going to happen. This ‘you’, who have been wandering outside, when you go there, you would be transformed, and then you would see who you are. You are the same Divine Light.
His womb is the womb of love. I'm going to be given rebirth from the womb of love. HKL.

talks.title: We are on a pilgrimage to meet ourselves and merge with God
talks.summary: There is a ladder within us, which has been furnished by the Divine, for us to move upward, to go to the Divine's mansion.
paragraphs: There is a ladder within us, which has been furnished by the Divine, for us to move upward, to go to the Divine's mansion.
This inner ladder is there for us to rise upward, to make our consciousness grow. Growth happens while it travels upward and then this ladder takes us into the mansion of the Divine.
Until, and unless we don't feel and recognise the Divine within, we never really become convinced, and totally convinced, that yes, the Divine is within. Until then, everything is hearsay.
While ascending upward on this inner ladder, while keeping the name of the Divine in our consciousness, and meditating, we would start rising upward.
When the Divine sends anybody into this world, He makes sure that the ladder of Truth within, is fitted within them.
The purpose is that, while remaining in the world, the world is going to hijack you, but you protect yourself, and keep ascending this ladder.

He says the world is going to marry you off, they would make sure that your connection with your insides is severed, and thus they will take you into the world, but I am sending you with this ladder, that ‘‘Keep hanging to this ladder. Then you would be fine.’’

The Divine is right there. In the beginning if we don't feel His presence within, even after doing meditation, then please, until then, keep feeling the dancing heart. It's the Divine who is dancing through the heart.

‘‘I'm grateful to be able to write to you. I'm noticing a lot of changes in my life recently. My perspective on life is evolving. Things are unfolding in a particular way. I am trying to be more careful with the words I say or not. The places I sit or stand, or not. Acts I do, or not. I think this is only the beginning.’’
This is the sign of a person, this is the sign of a consciousness which is waking up. This is the sign of awakening. Awakening is happening.
‘‘I definitely have found a purpose in my life, which is to be HKL. While doing my worldly duties.’’
How amazing! Right away! As soon as we wake up, we see that this is the purpose.
Your most beautiful state of consciousness is to recognise that you are humility, kindness and love, and that should be the goal of your life. That should be your destination.
‘‘I'm trying to spread the message of HKL, I would like to get better at this. Some situations feel hard to manage and live, but I am sure there is something to learn from those as well.’’

Until we wake up, we always find ourselves, our happiness, our fulfilment is dependent on others. This happens in sleep. The Divine would never create His children, whose happiness would depend on the outward events or people. Never.

He has furnished us with all these beauties. So the moment we wake up, we start to see the purpose and also to recognize that my happiness, my fulfilment, my contentment, has got nothing to do with anything outside.

Humility, kindness and love. Humility, kindness and love are buried deep within us. That becomes discovered through meditation, and once we reach that treasure, that's the most precious, rare, treasure, which makes our lives totally satiated, fulfilled, content, blossomed.
And these virtues bring stillness within us. That means that our mind stops running around, looking for love, looking for money, looking for so many things. No. They are right within us.
When we wake up, we are blessed with eyes of presence. There's no need to think, no thought comes, you just see the Truth.

He says, appreciate whatever you have, value it. Mind can never appreciate anything, mind can never value anything, mind does not value anybody. No. It only wants to go to somebody to get something, otherwise not.
This pilgrimage we are on, to meet ourselves, and merge with God.

talks.title: Aligning with Divine Will to Recognize Your True Self
talks.summary: Throughout the ages, it has been only the Truth. It is the Truth, Themselves, Himself, who is manifesting in His creation, through different forms, different shapes, different states of…
paragraphs: Throughout the ages, it has been only the Truth. It is the Truth, Themselves, Himself, who is manifesting in His creation, through different forms, different shapes, different states of consciousness. At the present, too, it's only the Truth wherever you see, and in the future, too, only the Truth is going to be there.
Yesterday, a daughter of mine from Toronto called, and I felt so much excitement in her voice. She said: ‘‘Baba Ji, I have to share this with you.’’

She said: ‘‘I knew… I had met this girl working as a physiotherapist sometime ago, and today, she just came into my mind and I called her to talk to her about HKL. And as I was telling her about the HKL Movement, that beautiful soul was crying, crying. And she said: ‘I'm so much...I'm surrounded by so much problems in these days, I didn't know what to do, where to go, where to start, and this call has shown me the path. It's not you who called me, it's God who called me.’ ’’

It's Him at work everywhere, especially when He orders His children to do something for His family, then He is always there with us, He never leaves us alone, that ‘‘You go and do it.’’ No, no. He says: ‘‘I will be right with you, all the time, everywhere.’’
Humility, kindness and love is the epitome of all virtues, all beauties.

With our actions while remaining surrendered to Him, and with His blessing, whomsoever He shows these virtues of humility, kindness and love within them, and taught them how to live while staying at that state of consciousness, He puts the crown of life on the head of that person. Crown of life.
This is the highest reward God gives to anybody. Epitome of all rewards. It's not something which can be taken easily.

To recognise ourselves, is to be successful in life. Success should not be measured so much by the position that one has reached in life; as by the others who have overcome so many obstacles while moving to success.
This service, which the Divine has entrusted us with, service to His humanity, is the highest service to Them.

Let's please feel the dancing heart. Those of us who have become even somewhat still, they can even feel the dancing heart in their ears. Let's feel the dancing heart, the Divine Himself is... this is His act.
Command and will are two different things. He commanded that ‘let him go into the world’, but that was not His will. Command and will are two totally different things. The word is Hukam.

It was not His will that one should destroy one's life – I'm not saying that whosoever goes into the world destroys their life – what I am saying is that there, you are going to sleep. And there is a chance that you can waste your life.
He says: ‘‘If your actions are aligned with the will of God, then you are going to reach the state where you will recognize that you are the Truth.’’

If we are suffering while walking this path, it means we have not understood the path completely. All he states of consciousness of all His creation and wherever one is attached to, they are happening under His command.
If we want to do something sinful, He warns us within, but if we still want to do it, then He commands ‘let him do it’ and also tells us that ‘whatever you sow, you will have to reap that.’

Only to humans He has given this freedom. And if one is doing noble deeds, then that is happening in His command as well as in His will. will. It's God's will that everybody should live life, the way God has designed it to be lived.

Now, it's His will, that the message should reach every human heart, that humility, kindness and love are those virtues with which we are blessed, and these are the virtues which take us to the state of consciousness where we recognise that ‘‘This is Truth, whom I have been calling ‘me’ ’’.
Those who live under His will, they are known as noble people.

‘‘When I'm with You, oh my Beloved, the Creator, I feel the whole world is mine. I feel the whole world is a family of mine. The whole world is collecting worldly wealths, some are collecting dirt, lands, and buildings. Some are rising upward to have more power, others are after fame and all that; those are their wealth's. But my wealth, oh my Beloved, is You. If I don't have You, I have nothing.’’

Now, how to have Him. First, to recognise that the space is the expanse of the Divine and we always dwell within Him. And when we are conscious that ‘I am dwelling within God’, instantly, my consciousness rises upward, and I get out of all the entanglements of the world, and I become still, peaceful.
Instantly, I get out of all the conflicts, all the miseries, anger, lust, greed, jealousy, stress, everything; just instantly.
The infinite skies is the infinite Divine Himself. The space, the skies, whom you don't even recognise, you don't even recognise the existence of the space, and the skies.
Right now, you cannot even imagine, let alone believe, but if you remember this – don't worry about believing, beliefs are just acts of mind, which has got nothing to do with the truth.

But if you remember this truth, that I am always dwelling within God, and if you remember it, keep it in your consciousness, then one day, you would see yourself, that you are the infinite skies. You are that.
You would feel yourself as infinite as the space. You would be one with Him. You would merge with Him.

Keep your hands folded, your head bowed and keep begging Him with utmost humility, that ‘‘Please make me realise who I am.’’ Keep your hands folded, head bowed, begging Him most humbly, while keep climbing the ladder upward, and remain upward.

Then you would one day, you must one day, with His grace, recognise that you are the infinite skies, you are the Truth. All His creation is within Him. Creation is also Him, within Him....all creation is within Him, attached to Him....all bubbles are attached to the ocean. If you do that, I know He will be merciful enough to make you realise that you, yourself are the truth.
We must build a house in our consciousness for the truth of life.
And the truth of life is that to have a beautiful, most satisfying, most fulfilling, successful life is to have the crown of humility, kindness and love.

These virtues, these goodnesses, make our lives so happy, so beautiful. The treasures of these virtues and goodnesses are found within us through meditating and keep ascending upward. These virtues, these goodness's are life's most precious and beautiful things.

If you have these virtues of HKL , you are the king of the world. Not that king of the world who has ego and those who want the others to live as they will, no. This king, this rule is the rule of humility. The name of this king is humility.
We are here to trade our lives with something. And this is the most precious trading there is in the universe. To trade our lives to be humble, kind and loving. Crown of life.
*Hukam = God’s order or laws under which He runs His creation

talks.title: Humility, Kindness, and Love: The True Wealth
talks.summary: The Divine has created this human body and this human body is a mare and the Divine is riding the mare. He is always with it.
paragraphs: The Divine has created this human body and this human body is a mare and the Divine is riding the mare. He is always with it.
The Divine is riding this mare, He has come to marry me off from the world. I am living in the world, and He has come to marry me and take me out of the world to His mansion.
The purpose of life; that we have been thrown into this world, the world of desires, sufferings, pains, insecurities, fears, all that, and He is here, already here, to marry us off.
It's the Divine power itself, which is dancing in the heart. Let's recognise, we can never recognise this blessing of His, the blessing of human body, human consciousness,
Everybody is, every body is priceless, because it is the abode of the Divine, it is the temple of the Divine, it's the living temple of the Divine, from where the Divine can be realised.

This very body, is the very place where we can meet God. Nowhere else in the whole universe. What value anybody can put on this, that where we can meet God, where we can know who am I? Please feel the body.

This letter from Melbourne, Australia, they write that: “After long prayers and begging the Divine, I am able to hear the dance of the heart now. And, when I listen to the dance of the heart, I feel the time has stopped; and I have entered into some, so beautiful, world.”
Like a river is running day and night towards it's Beloved, it's source, the ocean. She is so grateful to it's source, that You made me see the world.
You made me see the mountains, You made me see the plains, You made me see Your creation.

The river is so grateful, and running towards its source day and night, it wants to sacrifice its being, it wants to dissolve herself into her Beloved, her source. Dissolve into Him, lose it's identity.
We wake up in the holy congregation and the wisdom in us arises. That wisdom which feels our insides, that wisdom which feels the dancing heart.
Then, doing more and more and more Simran*, we reach a state where we recognise that it is Divine whom I have been calling 'me'. And this transformation happens in the holy congregation.
And in the holy congregation we fall in love with the Divine, as the river has fallen in love. Fallen. That's why it is flowing towards the lower levels, because it has fallen.

The river has fallen in love with the ocean, so it is moving to the lower grounds. So we fall in love with the Divine too. How? By becoming humble. It's the humility in us which unites with the Divine and makes us fall in love with Him. Humility, kindness and love; when they all come together.

In this mansion, whom I call my body, the Lord of the Universe is sitting there. We wake up, only through meditation, while keeping the name of the Divine in our consciousness. As long as we remain in thoughts, our consciousness is wandering everywhere. There is no chance for us to know who we are, because we are not still enough to know who we are.
The running river has to fall into the ocean, to know… When it becomes peaceful there, then it knows that ‘‘I was the same as the ocean. Ocean is made of water, me too.’’ Only, when she became still.
Our mind dwells at the naval point. Thoughts come at the forehead, but the seat of the mind is at the naval point, so when we are worried, anxious, you can feel the tension at the naval point.
Mind is tense, tension is at the naval point. So we have to release ourselves from the hands of the mind.

On one hand we are fighting with the mind to set ourselves free, and on the other hand, we are talking so lovingly to our mind. ‘‘Oh my mind, my so beautiful, lovely mind, come to the moment, come to the present, in the present we will meet our Beloved.’’
Singing is so important. Just like the meditation, Simran, singing also removes the blocks in the street of the present, which the mind has created with tension.

‘‘Oh my mind, let's go into the street of the present, there we are blessed with life. We are made to wake up. And the Divine, purifies us, imbues us with His love, decorates us with beautiful virtues of humility, kindness.

Let's go to the street of the Ishq*, let's make our house there, in the street of the present.” What one has, and what one does not have, they have absolute, absolutely nothing to do with waking up and recognising that ‘‘I am the treasure of all beauties, all true wealth's.’’
We are supposed to use wisely, what we have been blessed with, what He is blessing us, and what He is going to bless us with. Even the worldly things, we are supposed to use them wisely.

Who has a bigger house, bigger car, bigger bank account, has absolutely nothing to do with the beauty of life. Those things never make us peaceful, still. They never make us humble, they never make us loving, they never make us kind. The reverse happens.
‘‘Who is bigger, the one who has more worldly riches?’’ … ‘’No! The one who is united with God, that is the bigger.’’
To be great in life, is not to have those worldly things. To be great means, to become still enough, to recognise ourselves and recognise that this is the one...

The importance in human life is to be humble, kind and loving. This is the important thing. These are the big things in life. Not the big houses, and big cars and big chairs (note: Chair here means positions of worldly power f.e. In government offices or in companies). No, no.

We are on the way to merge with God, now, we have to work, because this opportunity happens once in many life times. And it requires all of us, all of ourselves. (note: “all of us” does not refer to us in numbers but in terms of it requires everything, all of our effort.)
We will have to change our habits, our priorities, because we are climbing on such a steep hill.

talks.title: To Listen to Truth is Such a Miracle
talks.summary: To listen to the truth, is such an accident in ones life which causes one to merge with God. To listen to truth is such a miracle. This miracle happens to the rare ones, and to whomsoever…
paragraphs: To listen to the truth, is such an accident in ones life which causes one to merge with God. To listen to truth is such a miracle. This miracle happens to the rare ones, and to whomsoever this miracle happens, they become one with the Divine.

So we can imagine that it's the rare ones who get to listen to truth. The Divine...the whole space, is nothing but the expansion of the Divine. And the Divine is vibrating...it's presence is vibrating in the entire universe, in the space, which is limitless, with a specific frequency, His vibrations are happening at a specific frequency. The Divine within us, is the same Divine, that too, within us too, the same vibrations are taking place at the same frequency as they are outside. But our insides, Divine's vibrations, and the sound are so subtle that they can only be heard when we become totally still within.

The purpose of the meditation is to wake us up. To wake our insides up, the process is, by making our insides vibrate, the word Waheguru is...four letters, are arranged in such a way — Wa He Gu Ru...four letters, or four sounds; are arranged in such a way, that it resonates with the frequency, with which the Divine is vibrating. So, the word Waheguru, creates vibrations which resonate with the Divine's vibrations throughout the universe. When we utter this word, it's frequency of vibration is the same. It resonates with the Divine's frequency of vibration, the Divine which is within us and without. So, by chanting this word Waheguru, because it resonates with the Divine who is sitting within us, the Waheguru word, sound, vibrations, resonates with the Divine's vibrations, so it makes the inner Divine's vibrations more audible.
Slowly, and slowly, our entire insides start vibrating with the same frequency as it is happening outside.

So, whichever word works for you, the main thing is, that we are on the path to merge with God. If any other word you feel more comfortable with, that's perfectly fine. The goal is to wake up, and recognise that we are filled with the Divine, we are nothing but the Divine Himself.

Through meditation we become fearless, because meditation wakes us up. Waking up means we start recognising that whom we have been calling 'me', is actually the abode of the Divine, and the Divine is fearless. That Divine is now coming up, it's revealing itself, it's overtaking, the regime of the mind is being overthrown.

The meditation makes the Divine within, vibrate with that frequency; that wakes us up, and the Divine starts revealing itself. The Divine's presence starts overtaking our thoughts, the way we look, the way we behave and we start feeling fearless, as the Divine's presence is becoming stronger and stronger, we feel fearless. It's not 'we' feel fearless, we are feeling that there is something fearless within. No longer there is any fear in me. That is actually the revelation of the Divine within.

But our relationship with Him is very important. The path is the path of love, which leads to the Divine's home, the Divine's mansion. Love. So, we must establish a very loving relationship with His presence.
Only those become imbued with the love of Divine, and Divine is love, who always remain, who always keep their face towards Him within, not looking here, there, everywhere.

And only those recognise the presence of the Divine, and get to know Him, only those, they get to recognise the Divine within and establish relationship with Him. It is only those, who establish so firm relationship with the Divine, those who know how to love.

Those who know how to love. We only know how to become attached with others, we don't know what love is. Only those who know how to love Him, they reach Him. Others fall off the path, because they didn't know how to establish that strong, pure, loving relationship.

They fall away from the path, because their relationship was not that strong, which would keep them pulling towards Him. Not to have strong unbreakable relationship with Him, does not take us anywhere. We can fall off the path anytime.

Many times we can rise up to some good heights, but if the love with Him is not that strong, we would fall and again, we would fall into the lap of the mind, mind — the house of sufferings, the house of resistance, negativity.
The meditation puts us on the right path to live human life. The right path is where our consciousness keeps becoming more and more pure, purer, purer, eventually holy, and it expands and grows.

Where our old way to live out of our minds, to live out of our thinking was the path, where our consciousness was becoming more and more impure, more and more impure by the day, and impurities in our consciousness, make us weak.
That's why many people fail to walk the path, even after knowing, that what a beauty this path is, the right path for humanity, for all humanity.

Meditation changes the direction of life, the meditation changes the direction of our life and we start feeling that every day, we are going to become more and more still, more and more beautiful, more and more loving, more and more, life is going to become truly glorious and celebrative.

Whosoever becomes awake and determined enough to walk this path, determined enough to get out of the hands of the mind — get out of the hands of the mind, which is resistance and negativity. Mind will never let us change, mind will keep us in that stagnant stage of consciousness.

Even the feet walking this path start throbbing with love — rom rom* — and we can start feeling the glimpse of such a beautiful face of ours. The youthful eyes of the world, youthful eyes, means whose insides are strong, that has got nothing to do with the strength of the body.

Whose insides are strong, who are determined to reach upward and desire to see how does the world look from up there! Those with youthful eyes, those with youthful heart, they become attracted to the right way of living life. They become attracted to rise upward and their lives become a story, a most beautiful, interesting story .

Oh my mind, you are always either in the past, or in the future, you never are here, you never let me live. Neither you can live, nor you let me live, life is here now within, upward, it's not left and right.
Oh my mind, please leave this habit of yours, and your habit of postponing, your habit of resistance not to do it.

Whosoever starts walking upward, the humility starts coming within them, more and more humility by the day. And one day their insides become ruled by humility. Every action they do is out of humility.
* Rom Rom: Every single hair pore or fiber of one's being.

talks.title: God Cares Whether We Are Available or Not
talks.summary: Waheguru. Let us please become focused at the heart area and pray to the Divine, that: ‘‘Oh my Lord, Creator, be merciful to me so that I may hear the truth.’’
paragraphs: Waheguru. Let us please become focused at the heart area and pray to the Divine, that: ‘‘Oh my Lord, Creator, be merciful to me so that I may hear the truth.’’

The Lord of the universe is sitting right within this body of mine. Right within this body of mine there is the mansion of the Divine, who is infinite, but He cannot be accessed through the mind. The mind's movement is always either in the past or in the future.
It's inaccessible to the mind. The Divine is inaccessible to the mind, mind is always in the past or in the future, parallel to the earth. But the path to His mansion is upward.

This week's commitment is going to be that many times during the day, we are going to become conscious about three things. One thing, that I am dwelling within the Divine. Second thing, the Divine is dwelling within me. Third thing, I'm always connected to the earth, which is most humble, most loving. So, I'm always connected to humility, I am always connected to love, I am always dwelling within God, I am always the house of God; the mansion of God.

If we have time, we should sit down, feel our feet connected to the earth and remember, I am plugged to the earth, I am plugged to humility, I am plugged to love. We must please, practise this consciously, many times during the day, and then this practise is going to transform us. This practise and the meditation.

We have been trying to understand, why there are sufferings, why we all are suffering. Because there are infinite number of things, articles, places, which are there in the bazaar of the world, and to sell those things to us, countless money is being spent and, in those advertisements, we are made to believe that I need it, because they are designed that way.

And whenever any of our neighbours, friends, relatives, anybody at work buys that thing, our mind says: ‘‘I need that, too. I need it.’’ That was not needed, that was a false need which was created by the world. Because of that, we remain stressed, because of fulfilling the false needs, we remain anxious, we remain unpeaceful, there are conflicts within us, around us, we are suffering.

We want to surpass others in this worldly race, and in this, such a strong storm, we are so badly surrounded by this so strong storm, that we don't know who we are, we don't know what I really need, we don't know what my interests are, we don't know what my capacity is, who I am. In that storm. Everyday… this person has become billionaire, that has become trillionaire… and, my relatives have bought another house to rent! Only, how can we stay sane in such a storm?

Please, this must be understood so clearly, that in our previous life time, we could not get out of this storm. That's why He sent us back and said: ‘‘Go back and do what you are supposed to do, recognise yourself, that you are, whom people call Divine.’’
It's another thing, at this state of your consciousness, you cannot imagine this, but change the course of life and you would start seeing the truth.

The whole world is suffering, the whole world is anxious, stressed, suffering in this race, the whole world. And HKL is to live the right path of life, where the path is just opposite to the path of sufferings.
To live out of mind is to be in misery, to be always empty, hungry, of so many things. But, as soon as we start walking the right path, which we are supposed to, upward; we become peaceful.
Oh my dear sister friends, I have heard the news today. What are the news? The news that I am always within my Beloved, always within Him and He is always within me.
And this news has made my body and mind so excited. I don't have to go anywhere to find peace, to meet God, to know who I am.
Walking that path to my Beloved's mansion, which is upward, I have become totally still within, satiated. All content.
Singing, what a way! Just singing puts us on that path, right path, to live human live.
Meditation makes our insides still, peaceful. All that storm around us starts disappearing, the moment we start meditation. There is no other way to become free of that storm.
Humility becomes the cup in which He pours the truth. Pours the truth, to drink.
Meditation is the answer to all the questions about life. Meditation is the solution of all the sufferings of humanity.

Those who start walking this path of life, ascending upwards, they start singing the glory of that path. The path of love. Pure love. This path, completely changes the direction of our lives. It puts us on a path which gives us everything which we need.

We look for love from others, but we find that love from others is conditional and not true, never everlasting. But love within, is unconditional and true love. ‘‘I'm the reservoir of love, I don't need love from outside.’’

There is a story, that once God was talking to Himself – like sometimes we talk to ourselves, too – and God was saying: ‘‘Whom should I put on the right path? Whom should I bring into my own mansion?’’

And people were listening and thinking: ‘‘Let's see whom He will pick.’’ ‘‘Whom should I put on the right path? Whom should I put on the path to my mansion?’’ One person stood up and bowed down to Him and said: ‘‘My Beloved, merciful Beloved, please put me on the right path.’’ and God did so immediately.
God does not care whether we are able or unable, God cares whether we are available or not available.
Only thing He sees, whether are we available or not?
You are not available, you are so much engrossed in that storm…
That's all He asks, would you give your hand to Me?

talks.title: The True Cause of Our Sadness and Suffering
talks.summary: Please let's become focused at the heart area, or keep feeling the dancing heart. The Divine is not away from you, you are that very One who remains in deep most profound bliss,…
paragraphs: Please let's become focused at the heart area, or keep feeling the dancing heart. The Divine is not away from you, you are that very One who remains in deep most profound bliss, intoxication. The most beautiful creation out of all His creation. Human body, human consciousness; which has the most evolved consciousness.

It's the humans whom He has blessed with most consciousness. The consciousness which can think, understand, feel. And if we are in suffering – which the whole world is – then the humanity has lost its way. And HKL , that's what HKL is all about.

Oh, my Beloved, the Divine, only You can save my honour. My mind makes me feel ashamed all the time, sometimes ashamed of myself, sometimes by making me angry, sometimes by throwing me into the greed, sometimes ego, attachment. All my mind can do, is to show the world how unwise I am.

We must know very clearly, the cause of our sufferings, the cause of our anger, the cause of our sadness, sorrows, repentance. We are in so much hurry… the cause is that our needs, what we need, God provides that to everybody, but in the world, there are millions of types of things in the bazaars today, for us to buy.

And, those companies are using billions, trillions of dollars to market those things, which are not our need. They market it in such a way, they research, they spend so much time in doing the research that how can this thing can be sold. And then it is marketed and it is sold to the minds that ‘‘You need it, you need it!’’, but we didn't need it.

They create a false need for us, a false need and we fall into their trap. Please understand this. A false need is created and we fall into that trap, and we forget what are my needs, what are my interests, and what is my capacity, and who am I?

False needs are created in our mind, by those giant companies and they are making so much money every day. They don't care about the world, they don't care about your health, or whether this thing could damage you mentally, or physically, no, that is not their concern. Their concern is to make as much money as possible.

He says through meditation, no suffering, no anguish, no sorrow, no sadness, no repentance, nothing can touch you. Why? Because as soon as you do meditation, meditation takes our consciousness from the hands of the mind and makes it rise upward, which was going left and right.

So meditation instantly brings us out of the hands of our minds and mind was the problem, mind was saying I need this, mind was saying ‘‘I need that type of house, palace. I need that, I need that palace. That Kings palace has 50 rooms.’’
You move into a 50 room palace and the family would be destroyed. Nobody would know anybody; where that person is… there would be no bond in the family… ‘‘But I need it!’’
Come upward and now look from here, do you need it? No… I just need one small room where I can stay in this state of consciousness.

Meditation, meditation is the answer to all the questions about life. Meditation is the solution to all our sufferings, anguish, sorrows. Life is to live naturally, and consciousness rises upwards, it's natural.

The nature of the mind is to follow the world, our innate nature is to be authentic, to live while remaining in the present and the consciousness keeps rising upward automatically, because that's natural.

There are two paths, one is path of the mind, which is like walking on a narrow path, on the earth. There are so many people, so much competition. There is so much hurry, anger, sufferings, sadness, because ‘‘I can't have this, I can't have that’’... and that path is a path in a forest – actually, there is no path, just to keep walking in the forest and one never reaches anywhere by living out of the mind, by keep walking in the forest. In the forest, there is only fear, insecurity, sadness.

And then there is another way, path of a rocket; going straight up, just by yourself. No crowd, no competition, nobody to have conflict with, no greed there, no attachment. No anger, just you alone in the wide open, tender love filled skies, because skies are the Divine. That is our natural way of moving, upward.

And, to have beard and hair, this is no statement of any religion, because this is not a religion. It's only a statement that I am living natural way. My body looks natural, as God created it. My consciousness is moving in its natural path. That's all. So simple. No religion, no nothing.

And HKL is all about this, to make the world do, to make the world live naturally. First we start living naturally, and then helping our brothers and sisters, the entire human family, help them to live the natural way.

talks.title: He Chose You for This Rarest Gift—Now Change the Ruler Within
talks.summary: Human life is the most precious gift from the God. It's most precious, as well as it's the rarest of the rare. Most precious and rarest of the rare, and when the Divine becomes so merciful…
paragraphs: Human life is the most precious gift from the God. It's most precious, as well as it's the rarest of the rare. Most precious and rarest of the rare, and when the Divine becomes so merciful upon some being, He blesses that being with the robe of human body.

In order to recognise this, only when we become peaceful within and can digest these words, and see the value and the truth of this, we won't be able to help, but cry, that He chose me? He chose me for this precious gift; for such a rare gift.

Except the people who are living spiritual life, everybody in the world is suffering. The causes of their sufferings could be different, but one thing is certain that they are suffering, and they want to change.
Mind itself feels the pain and mind itself gives birth to the pain. Mind feels the pain, our soul does not feel any pain.

Mind feels the pain and mind creates the pain. How? By creating false needs, or desires. It has been blessed with a house, but it wants house like that, as big as that house (another house), it has created the problem for itself.
Now, it's going to worry whether I would be able to do that or not, and the mind would ask, what's wrong with that?

What's wrong with that is, that whatever you are desiring, is not going to make you peaceful, and you want to be free of pains. What you are desiring is not going to make you free of pain. You don't want that house, you want to not have pain, and that's not the solution.
A foolish child, mind, is governing us. A foolish child. Now, the problem is that as long as this regime is not changed, there is no possibility of ever becoming free of sufferings.

Everything is now in such deep peace, comfort. Look at the arrangement of the Divine. He says, change the ruler, your ruler is the mind, which always remains either in the past, or in the future – you must change the ruler.
The new King must sit on the throne and that new King's way would be different. That new King won't go in the past or in the future, that new King will move upward.

You will become humble through meditation, and then humility would rule your insides. Now the mind is ruling. It's the meditation which causes the change of regime. There is no other way in the world to change that regime, the regime of the mind, except meditation. Simran*1.

We are going to hum*2, because humming is the path upward, this is the way to change the ruler of the insides. Humming. The name of God must be kept in our consciousness and by whatever name you feel comfortable, it's just fine, as long as it makes our consciousness move upward. We could use God, or Om, or Dios, or any word, whichever you prefer.

Yesterday was the birthday of a daughter of mine and she received a letter from the Divine. And she sent me that letter too, in which God says to her Happy Birthday to you, may you ever remain alive! Alive means who has life – God is life.

May you ever remain with God, may you celebrate your life with God, may you remain intoxicated with true love. I made you the truth, you are the truth, you are in fact totally peaceful, with the warmth of Ishq*3 and glory and the most loving sound.
You are the truth, you go within yourself, you meet the Divine, you sit with the Divine and sing songs of Ishq to Him.
When you feel the pain of separation from Him, your eyes tell it all, He immediately catches hold of you, takes you upward towards His home and makes you merge with Him.
May you be blessed with your true husband, true, who never changes, who never dies, who is out of birth and death, who is just Ishq. And may you find the true home of yourself, who is the Divine.

The King, yesterday's King, our mind… its biggest tool to use us, he uses our eyes, ‘‘I want that, I want that, I want that. ’’ Eyes. So we must take control of our eyes from it's hand and direct our eyes inward.

*2 The Humming Meditation: A meditation during which the divine name is being hummed and kept in the consciousness, taking the consciousness upwards *3 Ishq: Divine Love which happens only between the soul and God

talks.title: Learning how to truly listen
talks.summary: The word could be same, but everybody, the same word has different meanings, different understanding for every person, depending upon the state of their consciousness. That whosoever enters…
paragraphs: The word could be same, but everybody, the same word has different meanings, different understanding for every person, depending upon the state of their consciousness. That whosoever enters into this world they become entangled with their own minds, and become un-peaceful and never taste the peace. What do we understand by peace?
Peace is a state of consciousness. When the consciousness stops wandering, comes home, stays home and starts ascending upward, that is its natural state.

Peace means when our consciousness which constantly keeps wandering, comes home, stays home permanently within us, and starts ascending upward, starting from the lowest point in our bodies, through the naval point, heart area, throat, in between the eyebrows, tenth door and out. That is peace, peace.

Very few people are capable to listen. It is so, it’s a rare phenomena, when someone becomes capable of listening to the other. And that is when we are totally peaceful all of our consciousness is available to listening, available to listen. And once some statement of truth gets listened, that becomes the cause of transformation.
Whomsoever reaches the state of listening, then he starts doing that, too. He doesn’t keep thinking about it, no. He just starts doing. That is the secret of success.
We sit on the floor*1, because Earth is the most humble creation out of all of His creation. It’s so humble, it remains under our feet, remains under our feet. Humility.

Whosoever becomes successful in any field, they never become successful by chance. No, they had made choices. Choice, it’s the choice, not chance, that determines our destiny. It’s the choice we make.
Let us all say goodbye to our old self, which never gave us peace, lasting happiness. No. We cannot accept it.
The greatest act of faith is when we start moving, when we start changing, transforming ourselves. And refuse to live the same old way, with the same old thoughts.
Listening means, just to listen as it is, not to think, and not to filter what fits me and what does not fit me, what seems right to me and what does not. Humility.
That our old self had its own logic. That wandering consciousness of the mind had its own logic, but in truth there is no logic.
So please, we must admit that it’s not a field of the mind, it’s field of the spirit. It is to be drunk.

What is the logic that a chair on which we sit, which is made of dead wood, the presence of the Divine, in the form of molecules, are constantly moving in that chair, which is seemingly dead. What is the logic? So innocence is needed, humility is needed, humility.
Become dust of the feet of His devotee’s, become dust of the feet of those who love Him. You are a traveller, you are always travelling.
If you are travelling while remaining unconscious, you are travelling from birth to death. But if you are conscious, then you can travel from human consciousness to God consciousness.

But, if I may suggest you, undertake the journey to the mansion of the Divine, do meditation. Meditation will make you humble. Meditation will take you to His doorstep. Meditation will become responsible that you would be accepted by Him, you would be called in.

You are a traveler here and you are here on this planet to purchase the most precious, most beautiful, purchase. God. Divine. You are being called by Him, and you are standing and thinking. Opportunity would be gone.

Meditation and only meditation, makes us move from where we are. We are in the mind, not you, but those who are in the mind, in turmoil, in turmoil all the time. They want the things their way, but the things are going to happen God’s way. Meditation brings us home and makes us peaceful.
It’s the meditation which takes us out of the cycle of birth and death.

It’s the meditation which transforms our consciousness, and if we sit with closed eyes and do meditation, and if some word is not given to the mind to keep that in it, then the mind is bound to have thoughts and we cannot have any relationship with God.
When we keep His name, or His virtue in our consciousness, then we establish a relationship with Him and that relationship makes us humble. That relationship, because God Himself is humble.

That relationship with Him, makes us kind. That relationship with Him makes our consciousness to the state where it is always humble, kind and loving. So any word, whichever you want to use; God, Dios, Om. Any word, but we must keep one word in our consciousness, repeating that word while doing Simran*, only then we can have relationship with God.

Waheguru word is, if you want to try, you can use any word, but Waheguru word is a word designed by putting four letters in a particular order, which makes our entire insides vibrate. Makes our consciousness wake up and start ascending upward. This is — what we are — we are on the journey of merging with God, merging with God.
We are on a journey how to merge with God, it’s so serious, it’s not fun thing, it requires, intelligence, it requires humility, it requires the burning desire, it requires faith, trust.
*1Group HKL meditation sessions are often held while sitting on the floor for anyone who is physically able to do so
*Simran means remembrance, meditation, keeping God’s name in ones consciousness.

talks.title: We have to die from the life we are living now
talks.summary: Let us talk about our lives, your life and my life.
paragraphs: Let us talk about our lives, your life and my life.
Professor Puran Singh Ji writes to his friend, just a few lines.

When somebody; something dies, some person, bird or a tree, it feels like they have not gone anywhere, they have just descended down to their roots from where they emerged. For the worldly people this is a poem, like so many other poems people write.
He says, meditate and go deep into meditation, because if you want to know who you are, if you want to realise your true being, then you have to die. Not that worldly death, no.
You have to die from the life you are living now. You have to go through another door, in order to see yourself, who you are, and that door is through meditation and through deep silence.
By remaining the same, nothing can change. We will remain the same. That's the misfortune of the world, they want to live like they are living, and they also want to meet God. It cannot happen!
How beautiful it is. He says go deep into meditation. Become dead to the outer world. In that deep silence, you will enter into another world, the world of Truth.

You would feel like a flower dancing on it's stem, in that world of Truth. Totally blissful. Total bliss. Now you are dancing at your stem. Away from the earth, the worldly life. No misery, no suffering, no anguish, no fear can touch you.

There it would be natural for you to sing, like a bird sings on the branch of its favourite tree. How beautiful. To the worldly person, this would sound like one of the poems, so many people write poems, but how deep it is. How deep.
My ways of living are ill-ways. I'm living like the world, living out of my mind, which is always entangled in greed, attachment, lust, anger, ego. All those things.
But I have heard there is another world, the world of truth, which is the world of my Beloved and also my world, too, but I don't have those virtues to go into that world.

When I dwell within you, I am utterly at peace. The whole universe is nothing, but the expanse of truth, the truth itself. Even science knows that the whole universe is filled with universal consciousness, that is God.
Whenever I dwell within You, my Beloved, I am always very peaceful.
I was amazed to hear from somebody, that many people who are accustomed to living out of their minds, they don't even know what peaceful is.

The skies are nothing, but the Divine Himself. Even the science knows that the whole universe is filled with Divine or universal energy or consciousness. Energy is not the right word. Universal consciousness.
We are always within Him, but because we are always thinking, we don't know that we are already within God.
So, when I become aware that I am within You, I am sitting within You, I'm standing within You, I'm walking within You, I'm talking within You; I feel so peaceful.
The way the Divine has designed us, that to live human life, the consciousness naturally stays in the vertical position, which means in the moment.
So, meditation… to live in the moment, to come in the moment, to have the consciousness in a vertical state and ascending, that is our natural way.
But because we went astray, we forgot what is our natural way. Now our ways are not natural ways, they are the ways of the world.
Naturally, it is natural for us to be in the present. It's natural for us not to think about the past, or worry about the future, it's natural, but we are living unnaturally.
Now, many times during the day, we must check am I dwelling my natural way?
I was saying that during the Second World War, estimated of six million Jews were killed in camps, in gas chambers, in various ways. One of the prisoners, his name was Viktor Frankl.
His parents, his brother, his wife, were all killed in the camp. It was so horrible, even to live in those camps.

And one day, Viktor felt some weak movement within him. He stopped and started feeling that. He felt peaceful. So then every day, he would meditate and feel that movement within; that was the Divine Himself.
So he united with the Divine, with Divine's grace and his efforts he became so peaceful. The outside happenings did not disturb him. He became so peaceful.
He wrote a book called *’the last freedom of humans’; that freedom from the mind, until we become free of the mind, we will remain in its prison and its prison is so horrible.
When we meditate, when we come in our natural state of being, our consciousness moving vertically, we have become really free. Liberated. Emancipated. That's what enlightenment is. Liberation.

talks.title: We are not living: We are existing out of our ego
talks.summary: Professor Puran Singh, a saintly pure and highly evolved, celebrated soul, he wrote to his friend this small note, on March 3rd, 1928.
paragraphs: Professor Puran Singh, a saintly pure and highly evolved, celebrated soul, he wrote to his friend this small note, on March 3rd, 1928.

Your postcard I received. Did you not get my letter from Patiala? I did write to you one from there. I hope to be at Lyallpur in a day, on 13th of March. You might enquire from Sardar Sampuran Singh, with whom I'll be staying, it will be such a joy to meet you.
Be joyous, as the coming of new spring with life full of flowers
Glory reigns everywhere and God is the most beautiful presence
To live in human life is such a glorious opportunity, to dwell with God
He said be happy like a flower, dancing on it's stem or be overjoyed like a bird, on the branch of a tree.

What would we understand what he is talking about. He says be happy like a flower, on the stem. We don't know. To us, flower is not something like us, who becomes happy or sad or angry or anything. No. We don't know him. We can't feel how the flowers feel. What would we understand by these statements of Professor Puran Singh, when he writes to his friend? Be happy like a flower on it's stem. Be overjoyed on the branch of a tree.

As long as we are in the minds, and the whole world around us is living out of their minds, what minds would guess? Even guess? Let alone feel. What minds can guess how does a flower feel on a stem? On it's stem? How does a bird feel sitting on the branch of a tree?
We are surrounded by minds – where we never live. We remain in thoughts. Engrossed in thoughts, worries, illusions, misery, fears; all that.

We are somewhere else in the mind and the life is somewhere else. We remain somewhere else, while the life remains somewhere else, we never meet life. We never get to know what life is. And the whole world is believing that they are living, they are not living, they are existing out of their ego.

Humility. Humility is the one which lets somebody's words enter into us. Humility. Ego, never. Ego would remain on the defensive. Ego remains the same. Same habits, same life, same. But this opportunity is so beautiful. Every statement about the truth, about our true nature, can only be heard, can only enter into us through the gate of humility and love. And that gate is heart; gate of the heart.
The game of waking up and remaining awake, is the hardest thing to do. Only the blessed ones who are humble enough, who are loving enough, they are made to experience what life is.

If you don't meditate now, if you don't wake up now, then when are you going to wake up? Never. It's either now, or never. It's either now or never. Only those who are humble enough, and longing intensely enough to wake up and to live out of our true self, only they are blessed with this.
This sign, should always remain before us, should follow us. That I am not happy, I am not content, I am empty, I am only full of desires, and I don't know who I am. Then we would feel pain within.
This letter from Toronto, in which the writer, writes that:
‘‘Oh my Beloved, whom can I narrate the state of my insides? Empty. Unhappy. Sad. Please come and meet me and the path of life without You, is the path of emptiness.’’
How to meet our being, how to meet the Divine, and how to merge with God. If we are really thirsty, if we recognise the pain within, which is buried under illusions; only then this would...

The sacred name of God is nectar, which liberates us from our ego, from our false self and makes us experience that our true self, our innate nature, is deep bliss. Sukhmani. Sukhmani. The name of God.

Oh my Beloved, the Creator, except You, whom can I tell my plight? Only You know it. Have mercy and come and meet me. Please come and bless me with the sacred name, so that becomes the vehicle, that becomes my guide to take me to You. Come and write in my fate that I will keep Your name with me; to reach You.
His devotees will keep His Name with them. They become the embodiment of peace. We and Him are one. Let's beg Him. Please make me feel, let me feel the truth that You and me are one.

Today I was talking to Your creation, oh my Beloved, and I felt that it was just You. Somewhere, You are hiding behind a tree. Somewhere, You are hiding behind a bird. Somewhere, You are hiding behind humans.

But those were Your veils, I felt; I felt Your presence, then all of a sudden You disappeared--I stopped feeling You and I asked You why? Why I don't feel You now? And You said, because you are looking at My veil. You are looking at some human body, which was My veil. The moment you started looking at the body, the veil, I disappeared. If you want to behold Me, you have to go beyond what is the scene.

When I was looking at some person, You disappeared. I asked You humbly and You said: You started looking the body. You started looking the flower. I'm not the flower, I'm the fragrance in it. I'm the fragrance in it.

Oh my Beloved! I forgot again. I forgot again. I again started looking at the bodies. I am folding my hands with utter humility and begging You again and again, please forgive me and don't hide from me.

This letter from Melbourne, Australia. The writer says, that I have a four year old child and as children do at this age, he talks a lot and many times I used to become frustrated and angry with him and since you have asked us to listen or talk to anybody while staying at the heart, now I remain so peaceful, when I remain at heart while talking to him or listening to him, and my insides remain so happy.

Practising. Practising staying away from the mind and staying with our soul. Practising that. When we talk and listen to others while staying at the heart area, we are away from the mind. Mind is at the forehead, inside the forehead.
And every day please, report to the HKL Head Office. That report, you would see that it changes us ten times faster.

talks.title: We Are The Love That Does Not Need Any Love
talks.summary: Those of us who have arrived at the state where we can listen to the truth, not through the ears, not through the mind, but through the heart, that’s the only way utterances of truth can be…
paragraphs: Those of us who have arrived at the state where we can listen to the truth, not through the ears, not through the mind, but through the heart, that’s the only way utterances of truth can be heard, received, drunk.
In that state, the ones who are listening through the heart, they are holy. They are becoming holy. And those who are talking about Him, they are becoming pure. Pure.

Pure is not the ultimate state. Pure can become impure. Once we become holy, there is no way to become unholy. And when you become holy, then every pore of your body, every ounce of your consciousness, speaks when you speak, sings when you sing.

If you ever meet the True Guru, who is the primal being, then rejoice His pure love. Rejoice His pure love. If you ever meet, if you are so generously blessed that you have the fortune to meet a True Guru, who is one with the primal being, the Divine, then recognise the pure love in Him.
The True Guru is all pure love; just pure love. Open to Him. Open yourself to Him, let the pure love in Him flow into you.

And there would be a sign of the True Guru, that He would not expect anything from you, He is all fulfilled, there is no room in Him for anything else to enter. He is all full, full of love, pure love.

Fully open yourself to Him. Don’t think! Do not try to understand, do not try to make sense, what can a poor mind understand about the truth? Guru is the truth, and truth does not belong to any religion, any group of people. No group of people can claim that truth is theirs! Truth belongs to all. Truth does not recognise any religion, it is we, the poor ones…
The path of love is known as the path of the Kings. Path of the Kings. That you don’t have to go to the mountains, to the Himalaya’s, to the caves; no—while living in the world.

In every, my life time, in this life time too, He has been calling me, ‘Listen, listen, listen to Me, you are in such a hurry to reach somewhere in the world; nowhere you are going to reach there.’ He has been calling me and calling me constantly, I can’t imagine anybody having patience like He has.

He is all fulfilled. He doesn’t need anything. Still, He keeps calling me everyday all the time. He has no selfish interest in talking to me. He is all fulfilled. Even then, He is so much interested in me, He keeps calling me, He keeps being worried about me, I always wonder why, He doesn’t need anything from me. Why? He remains focused on me.
I keep thinking why? Why? But, my mind, poor mind, cannot imagine the true story.
This is a letter from a son of mine from Toronto. He says this humming meditation is so powerful that I sat down to do it and it has been a few hours and still I don’t want to get up and leave.

I feel within, as if I’m travelling all the universes in deep silence. I feel like my insides have become the string music, rabab. This meditation is so peace giving, making content, that I don’t feel like leaving it. When I open my eyes, I immediately want to close my eyes and go back into the humming meditation.
This eliminates all the conflicts within us. Makes us peaceful. Content. This opens our heart. Opens a way to our insides through the heart, this humming meditation.

Earth is most humble amongst His creation. Most humble. There is nothing humbler than the earth, it remains under the feet of everyone, as long as they live, and when we die, it covers our…not that…no longer, any beautiful face. It covers us.

And we sit on this earth. We connect ourselves with the most humble of His creation. We should feel humility, remain conscious about our insides and on top of that, this humming meditation, while sitting on earth, it just makes us feel humility in us, so much faster.

I’m so – everlastingly – so grateful to all of you. Because of you all, this path to the mansion, path to the court of the Divine and the right way of living human life, while remaining in the present, not thinking, not getting worried, not getting stressed, no fears, no insecurity’s; just bliss, bliss.

So, through the humming meditation, we learn how to stay in the present, how to walk the journey of life, the way the Divine wants us to do, which, immediately, takes us out of our thinking mind consciousness in horizontal state, to the vertical state in the present, where there are no worries, no stress, just bliss.

HKL Movement, the great good news to everybody, to all humanity, to all the universes, that the HKL Movement has been embraced by 83 countries now, and it is spreading so fast. And what a life, what a karwan* (caravan) of beautiful souls. Beautiful souls. Humble souls. Kind souls. And, we are going to walk the path which would make us merge with God. That’s what we are doing. It’s very blessed moments, blessed days, blessed souls.
* ਕਾਰਵਾਂ (Karwan): A poetic or formal term for a procession or traveling party.

talks.title: Why it is so Difficult to Hear the Truth
talks.summary: Remember the Divine, by staying at the heart area. If we listen to it with our minds, then what does mind do? Because mind is always connected with the world. When mind listens to it, the…
paragraphs: Remember the Divine, by staying at the heart area. If we listen to it with our minds, then what does mind do? Because mind is always connected with the world. When mind listens to it, the mind thinks that it’s being said to the whole world, it’s being told to the whole world, the game is lost.
Nothing entered within, we did not let that enter into us, but the way to listen to the statements of the truth, is not through the mind please, it’s directly through the heart.
Whatever we listen through the heart, only that enters into us. Only that enters into our consciousness, only then, we can achieve a lasting peace.

If we listen through the mind, we may feel that we have listened, but it was not listened. That’s why we will be pulled back into the same old world of illusion of our thoughts, and we would fall back into the space of worries, anger, anxiety, fears, all that.
People listen to the statements of the truth with their minds and minds judge that, mind does not believe anything.
So, the truth is not to be heard with mind, it is to be drunk directly with the heart.
When we were humming yesterday, the sacred word, while staying at the heart, we were making ourselves capable of listening to Him.
Innumerable life times, you have been coming and going, you never became peaceful, you never came home, that’s why this is happening to you.
The mind, the thinking consciousness, keeps us having regrets, wounds of yesterday, fears of tomorrow, this mind is not my friend. He is a very low being, very low being.
We must recognise this please first, that I am not happy with myself.
Ever since I stopped looking towards You, oh my beloved Creator, the life has become angry with me, it's punishing me, through keeping me in thinking.

This must be understood very clearly, that HKL is not something to talk about, that we should become humble, and kind and loving. How do we become humble? No, that would be acting, and we can become so expert in acting, that we would move even further from our true self. We should have a very clear understanding about humility.

Mind can never become humble. Mind is ego. Pride. Our heart is humble. Until we learn to live while staying at the heart, we can never become humble, it’s not something to talk about, it is something to experience, that this is who I am.
That ill-way, which keeps us in worries, and mind is so deeply conditioned that nothing new it’s open to listen.

I was saying that this daughter of mine, who is from Switzerland, she works in Dubai and she travels. Five weeks ago, she wrote to me and she said that ‘I want to serve God, I want to serve humanity, but I don’t know what’s the best way to serve humanity.’

I said, ‘just do the weekly commitment of HKL . Just for four weeks, so that you can see yourself. Every day, you practise that, and then send me the report of the week that you did practise and how the week was.’

She promised me. I said ‘after four weeks, if you don’t see any change in you, then leave it, then there is no point in doing it.’ The day before yesterday, I received this report from her, for the fifth week. She writes:
I send you again my weekly feedback of my daily commitments to peace, humility, kindness and love. This week feels so uplifting and wonderful for me.

I am attending a Kirtan here in Switzerland and I found out that the singing opens my heart so much. I find that singing opens my heart so much. I feel gratitude, I feel love, I feel kindness. I am humble now. Wherever I see, I see through humility, kindness and love.

I am surrounded by the most beautiful souls, by great examples of high living. That these people who do Kirtan and sing, they are great examples of high living. I observe my heart, my whole being, it's dancing in joy and I am feeling very, very present.
What a wonderful week. How lucky I am. How fortunate it is. Now, Baba Ji, I am talking about HKL to whomsoever I meet. Thank you so much.

I ask all my western children, sons and daughters, please, our mind will not let us, but without practising, nothing will change in us. Nothing will change in us, we will remain in the same old ways and believing that ‘I am grown up, I know everything, this practise is for those who don’t know, but I know everything.’ So, mind… mind is not our friend.

talks.title: We Have Not Been Living, We Have Been in Thinking
talks.summary: These days are so precious: where first we are going to realize our true self, our being, then the Divine, and then merge with the Divine.
paragraphs: These days are so precious: where first we are going to realize our true self, our being, then the Divine, and then merge with the Divine.

This is our purpose on this planet. We have not been living, we have been in thinking, in thinking. We were living while we were in thinking. In thinking means: we were always either in the past or in the future. Never in the present, and hence, never lived. We must starting today, start living.
And that old self must leave us, or we must take exit from our old self. The old ways of thinking, the old habits, the old ways of reacting. We never lived.
Whosoever is sent into this world, the way He has designed this play, whosoever comes into this world, becomes entangled with the world.

In this play, so many souls have been covered in many other forms. Trees, animals, birds, fishes, all those. And we are so unbelievably blessed to have the human bodies. Because we don't live, we always remain in thinking, and so we never appreciate this. So we must start living.

Thinking happens: the thinking keeps us in the horizontal state of consciousness, which moves parallel to the Earth. In the past, in the left, or in the future, right. Living happens. We become alive when we become present.
To live means we have to be here to live. When we are thinking we are never here.
Such a blessing, such an opportunity, such a precious form and precious opportunity. When we become alive, when we wake up, then our consciousness moves vertically, upwards, in the street of love.

Once we wake up, we would be stunned and sad to see that how humans are wasting their such an opportunity. How humans are asleep towards their invaluable wealth of human body and human consciousness. You would become sad that how everybody is wasting their life.

We wake up. The only way to wake up is through meditation. Meditation brings us in the present. And when we come in the present, then we watch that our consciousness does not move horizontally. It moves upward. Means what? As long as we are in meditation we’ll remain awake.

I wake up. As I meditate, I wake up, and I find myself peaceful. As long as we remain asleep means as long as we remain in the thinking mode of our consciousness, there will always be conflicts within. There would be fears; there would be anger; there would be regrets; there would be complaints; there would be fires of lust, anger, greed. There would be conflicts within us, within the family, within others, conflict between countries and all that.
