What's the root? Root is the thinking process. Root is the sleep.

Please, we must understand to the deepest core of our being, that awakening can only happen through meditation. Meditation means to come in the present and feel our being. And the only way to wake up is by remembering God. By remembering God.
When we remember God, God reveals Himself within us. The problem with the mind is that it does not drink what is. Drink the the statements of truth. It filters, but we must learn to drink.
The word Waheguru is not just a word, which means 'wonderful Lord'. It's not just a word. It's a tool to meditate. Because when we enter this word, it awakens our insides.

Our thinking consciousness is not going to hum. That remains outside. That is for the outer world. This humming, which is we are going to do, our souls would be humming, if we become totally focused. Let us hear our souls.

Please let the old die. We were not that. We are something so beautiful: alive, throbbing, rejoicing, celebrating. Get out of the thinking. They will never let you wake up and taste what human life is. What human consciousness is.

Wake up and recognize that you are a guest here. You are on a journey here. You are not going to be here forever. You are a traveler. You are a traveler. So far you have been going in rounds, wandering, thinking and wandering. You have to travel and the path is upward. You have to travel. You are a traveler, and the path is upward.
Become dust off the feet of those who are walking to the Divine's home, Divine's mansion. Become the dust off their feet. That's the only way your old false self can die. Otherwise, it would never...

Stay at the gate of the heart area. By staying there, their consciousness becomes humble, utterly humble, and only those are called inside into His Court. Only those who become utterly humble, kind, loving, only they're called in into His court, which is within this body.
You are a traveler here. You have been only wandering in the past and the future. You have never traveled. The path is upward. The path to travel is upward. That is also called, "panth". The path.

For the coming week, we all are going to hum the word, Waheguru. This word is a tool to wake us up and to bring us into the present. This word is a tool to meditate. This word, when it's hummed within, it awakens our insides.

So for the coming week, many times, every day, we are going to hum the word. And this is going to make us -- to wake us up. And when we wake up, we would find that our consciousness is humble, kind, loving.

talks.title: The Courage to Know the Self
talks.summary: A journey where we feel that human consciousness, which is necessarily ego consciousness, is actually, this is false consciousness: ego consciousness.
paragraphs: A journey where we feel that human consciousness, which is necessarily ego consciousness, is actually, this is false consciousness: ego consciousness.

Ego consciousness means that consciousness is not pure; there is some mixture in it. And on this path, the consciousness keeps shedding the impurities of lust, anger, attachment, greed, jealousy, all those, and it starts becoming pure, holy.
That's pure consciousness. The pure consciousness is God's, God's consciousness. And what a, what an experience it is. What an opportunity it is, and what a blessing it is.

So without experiencing who we are, to live life and then depart from here, while living in ego consciousness and never knowing who this was, whom I have been calling 'I', is such an unfortunate happening.
But how blessed we all are that he has put us on this sacred journey.

Whosoever becomes a watchman and stays at the heart area, stays at the gate of the heart, stays at the gate of the heart. Gate of the heart is actually just behind our heart. There is a small place which takes us inside. It is called street of ishq. Street of love.

Whosoever remains at the heart, one day, the doors are open to Him. The Divine opened the door to Him. Through the heart area, just behind the heart, and we enter into the street of love. That street takes us to our being. That street takes us to our being.
So the way to our being is through the heart, through the street of ishq. Just enter through the heart. You cannot enter into that state through the mind. You have to enter through the heart.
Through the street of the heart, just behind the heart, a small, empty, narrow street. But don't worry about that. That...we enter into the inner world, and we realize our being.

So the path to our being is through the heart and path to the universe, or God, is through our being. Path to our being is through the heart, and path to the universe, or path to God, is through our being.

We are on this journey. Brave people undertake this place, transforming journey, and the Divine's grace upon us makes us brave. To have the courage to change ourselves, to have the courage to die: become totally new. It requires real courage.

Only courageous people undertakes this journey. Others, others are not determined enough. They can follow up the path today or tomorrow, or six months from now. No, brave, brave, and heart is brave. Heart is brave.
Only those will enter into the street of ishq, who would be there standing at the door, waiting for the door to open. So we must go to that door and stay at that door. This requires courage, courage.
We must listen through the heart. Listen through the heart.

Upon whom He has His grace, His mercy, they're known as His people, 'the Divine's people'. They're no longer slaves of the world, no longer, they don't follow what society tells them. No, they're not people of the world. Their world is totally different.
We are the temple of divine light. The divine light. Ego consciousness: I am a divine light, but my thoughts always remain ego centered about me, about -- about my identities.

The ego consciousness always wanders in an horizontal level. This thing must be understood very clearly. It keeps wandering parallel to the Earth horizontally. So the ego consciousness always travels, wanders around horizontally. Same identifying like -- identifying with different people, different countries, different things.

That's why we never change. We remain the same, and this, this consciousness is bound to have conflicts with. Because of this consciousness, it's wandering around just like aimlessly. It is bound to have conflicts with others. Conflicts with relationships, conflict with others. Conflicts of countries, and all this, because of this thing.
And its behavior remains bound by anger, attachment, lust, ego, and same behavior remains throughout the world, throughout our lives. Same behavior. No growth ever takes place.

In order to transform ourselves from ego consciousness to God consciousness, the path is vertical: upward. Upward, straight like an arrow. On that path, the consciousness starts becoming pure and expanding. Expanding.
Previously its world was only small world: family, friends, people at work. Now it starts expanding.
The transformation only happens through actions, through walking that path. Nothing changes if we do not walk that path. The path, the vertical path.

HKL, HKL is not about just talking about humility, kindness, and love. It is becoming that. It is realizing that I am this. It is recognizing that I am. As we start walking this path, vertical path, we would start feeling that I am becoming humble. I'm becoming compassionate. I'm becoming kind, loving, peaceful.
The ego consciousness which travels horizontally, can never become peaceful. Can never become free of lust, anger, greed, attachment, ego, all those things.
So first thing, we should very clearly understand that we cannot recognize ourselves, that this is a God consciousness by remaining where we are, by remaining in that horizontal consciousness.
While living there, in ego consciousness, we can never become humble. We can never become kind. We can never love anybody. Pure love, purely. Pure love, without any reason, expectation, or desire.
The very first step is to take exit from this horizontal consciousness, horizontal way of consciousness, to the vertical path. Vertical path.

Transformation will only occur if we take exit and keep -- start walking. So from now onward, whenever we talk to anybody, we should make sure that we remain at the heart area. When we listen to anybody, we should listen through the heart. Instantly our lives will become peaceful, fearless. Fearless.

Those who keep standing at the gate of the heart, and sincerely, patiently, stay there. That we must keep rooted, grounded at the gate of the door, at the gate of the door. [Baba Ji laughs] That's strange. At the gate of the heart.
As the trees never move. May there be storm, hail, flood, whatever. They may be broken, but they stay there. They stay there.
One day, the Divine opens the door, and Divine has pure love in His treasure, and he gives pure love in arms to the one who has, who had been, staying at the door of the heart.
He doesn't charge us anything for the arms of pure love, and He blesses us with pure love according to the intensity of our desire to travel that path.
HKL is not just to talk about this. HKL is to experience this, is to recognize that this is me.
Let us commit to transform ourselves, that's all. Let us commit to practice. Let us commit to take action. That's all. If we do not commit to it, there's no way of reaching anywhere.

Our consciousness, the way to merge our consciousness with the Divine consciousness. Within this body of yours, the boat which takes you upward, this is how your consciousness will merge with God's consciousness.
Within you the divine light is burning. Go within. See that for yourself and keep that burning.
Day and night the divine light keeps burning. It Never become tired. It never becomes tired.
How to merge with God. We are on a journey. How to merge with God.

Oh my beloved, this life, I'm in darkness, but you are telling me it's night where the divine light is burning. This is a night of, night where divine lamps are burning. We all are divine lamps. We all are burning divine lamps.

talks.title: Why We Remain the Same Even After Years of Seemingly Spiritual Life
talks.summary: The divine has equipped us to live human life in two different ways.
paragraphs: The divine has equipped us to live human life in two different ways.
One is the way we are living in where there is always fear, unpeacefulness, and all that: fires. This is one way.
And then he shows us. He says, 'This is not the right way.' If there are two ways to live life, both cannot be right. It has to be one. Otherwise why two right ways would be there?

The way we are living life is not the right way because it does not make us peaceful. It does not make us feel us humble, kind or loving, or as if we are celebrating life. There's no celebration. There are sufferings.

The way we are living. When a thought comes, it brings emotion with it. A thought comes that: 'My boss is not happy with me. I may lose my job.' No job has been lost. Nothing has happened, but a thought came and it scared us.
'I want to sit in this examination. I'm scared. I may not qualify for admission to that course.' That scared us. No exam has been taken yet. We are not failed, but we are already in fear.

Everyday this is our story. The whole life. We live in fear. Because everybody around us is that way, we have taken it that this is the way life is. No, that's not. Those thoughts are not us. All our lives we spend in fear, in thoughts, in false. That's false. That's not us.

So the moment -- now we must wake up. That old self must go. Human life is not to suffer, not to be miserable. It is to celebrate. It is to celebrate recognizing that it's just Him. It is just love. It's just humility. It's just kindness.

One may read religious books, but his fear will not go. The fear will remain. Then what is the solution? If we can wake up even -- if we fully wake up even for the duration of one breath, we would recognize it is all Divine. Divine.
Our old identity, we must leave that here tonight and go home with a new one. We won't become the new one overnight, but with the thought at least.

Because the thoughts keep coming to us, and thoughts are just dreams, and dreams happen in a sleep state. So the continuous traffic of thoughts is the proof that we are not awake because we are dreaming. And that's how the whole life is wasted, just in dreams.

We would be talking with alternative -- talking about two alternative ways of living human life. Two states of consciousness. One is this state of dream state, and the other, is the state where we become awakened.

So, there are two ways to live human life. One is ill ways. Ill ways of living human life where we do not really live. We experience whatever we experience in a dream state. That's why no experience changes us.

Whatever we experience, we are experiencing in a dreamlike state. The same old habits, the same old fears. Why? We could not wake up. Because we never listen what is said. We listen, part of it. We filter whatever is said, and then we only listen what fits us.
Why this is happening to us that our habits remain the same; the same way of living life, the same way we behave, everything? Because we filter what is - what fits, suits us, and what doesn't.
If He says that the people, the things and the places you are attached to, these are the very reasons for your sleep, but we don't listen because we don't want to become detached.
If He says, your life is shortening by the breath, by the day, by the night, wake up; we don't listen.
We only listens what does not disturb us. Please understand this. We only listen to what does not disturb us, and He disturbs us. He tells us the Truth.
Truth cannot be listened by these ears. Truth only gets listened by the heart.

practices.body: We must remember the truth, that God and his creation are one. Our creator is sitting within us. Our soul and God are together in this body. They're not separated. God is with me all the time. It's God's presence in all his creation. So we must, from now onward, always remember that I'm never alone.

originalValues.Humility: Humility is the opposite of Ego. Ego is the false idea that we are separate from, or better than, others. It is the “I, Me, and Mine” voice in our head that constantly seeks to possess and gain attention, credit, and control. Humility arises out of the consciousness that is grateful.
originalValues.Kindness: Kindness is the opposite of self-centeredness. Kindness is rooted in humility and arises from the deep understanding of truth that all life is interconnected, calling us to treat every being with care & compassion.
originalValues.Love: Love is the universal force, arising from humility at the heart of all life. To love is to surrender unconditionally. As the heart awakens to love, separation dissolves- fear and hatred fall away and we recognize our oneness.

originalMission: The HKL Global Movement is dedicated to inspiring everyone to awaken, go within, and reconnect with the virtues of Humility, Kindness & Love (HKL) that already exist in all of us.
As we do so, we become more beautiful. From that arises peace, happiness, lasting contentment, and ripples of positive change in our homes, communities, and the wider world.
At a time when humanity is often clouded by ego, division, and disconnection, HKL offers a path back to Truth.
